explanation: tRNA (transfer RNA) matches anticodons to mRNA codons and delivers corresponding amino acids.
Helicase, Polymerase, and Ligase are DNA replication enzymes. Amylase is a digestive enzyme.
There are 9 essential amino acids: histidine, isoleucine, leucine, lysine, methionine, phenylalanine, threonine, tryptophan, and valine.
